title: Unconditional
summary: UNCONDI'TIONAL, adjective Absolute; unreserved; not limited by any conditions. We are required to make an unconditional surrender of ourselves to our Maker. The king demanded unconditional submission.

inlines.v: UNCONDI'TIONAL, adjective Absolute; unreserved; not limited by any conditions. We are required to make an unconditional surrender of ourselves to our Maker. The king demanded unconditional submission. O pass not, Lord, an absolute decree, or bind thy sentence unconditional
